page.overview:
Who is Raze?

Raze died in the fighting but was successful in slaying her opponents, and was honored by the Mandalorians with a kote ky'ram—a Mandalorian death ceremony that saw them burn her body on a pyre and spend a night in celebration of the fallen's feats. By 3630 BBY, Raze was the only non-Mandalorian to ever have received the honor.

Raze was mentioned in the "Mandalorian Death Ceremony" Codex entry in Chapter XIV of Knights of the Fallen Empire, the 2015 Digital Expansion to the 2011 BioWare video game, Star Wars: The Old Republic.
